Title: WHITE FOREST STRAWBERRY
Body (HTML): A sweet, fruity feminine built around fresh strawberry and white florals over a creamy musk base. Light and playful — it wears like a summer treat on the skin, fresh and delicate without being too simple.

Title: WHITE HEART
Body (HTML): Bright and clean with a warm finish — like fresh citrus on a white linen shirt. Orange, bergamot, and lemon open with crisp energy, soft fruits bloom in the heart, and white musk with amber and vanilla settle it into something smooth and wearable every day.

Title: YARA CANDY GIFT SET
Body (HTML): The Yara Candy gift set — full EDP, travel spray, and hair mist. Playful and sweet from start to finish. Black currant and tangerine open bright, strawberry candy and gardenia bloom in the heart, and vanilla with amber and musk settle into something joyfully addictive. A perfect feminine gift.

Title: YARA TOUS PERFUME MIST
Body (HTML): A long-lasting body mist version of the iconic YARA TOUS — sweet, fruity, and floral with notes of orchid, heliotrope, and warm musk. Light enough for everyday layering, with that signature Yara softness.

Title: YOUR TOUCH FOR MEN 100ML
Body (HTML): Crisp and layered — like a man who's perfectly put together without trying. Cardamom, pink pepper, and mint open sharp and cool, cinnamon and lavender warm the heart with a touch of fresh pineapple, and vanilla with amberwood and cedar settle into a smooth, masculine dry-down. Confident from first spray to last hour.

Title: ZUKHRUF POUR HOMME
Body (HTML): Spicy, bold, and unapologetic — like burnt caramel mixed with black pepper on dark wood. Cinnamon, grapefruit, and nutmeg open with heat, lavender and iris cool it down slightly, and vanilla with sandalwood give it a rich, smoky finish. A fragrance that commands attention.
